# Blueprint code → Figma

Build a **composed screen** in a target Figma file from React (examples, stories, or app pages) by **importing published Blueprint component sets**, not by drawing boxes.

This skill is the Blueprint overlay on the Figma plugin skills. Always load both before any write:

1. Cursor plugin skill **figma-use** (API rules, fonts, sizing, error recovery)
2. Cursor plugin skill **figma-generate-design** (section-by-section assembly, wrapper-first)

Pass `skillNames: "figma-use,figma-generate-design"` on every `use_figma` call.

## When this skill applies

- User gives a Figma URL (`figma.com/design/:fileKey/...`) and a React source (example `index.tsx`, story, or page).
- Goal is a **first page / first state** of that UI in Figma, linked to `💎 Blueprint / components`.
- Opposite of **tune-component** (Figma → existing `Bp*` code).

**App-repo prerequisite:** confirm the Blueprint agent bundle is readable before the first `use_figma` write.

1. Try Blueprint MCP (`guidelines-layout`, etc.). If MCP is unreachable, fall back to `node_modules/@netapp/blueprint/agent/manifests/docs.json`.
2. If neither is available, stop and tell the user to install `@netapp/blueprint` or configure the Blueprint MCP. Do not invent component names, variant IDs, or node IDs.

## Hard constraints that burned time

### Slot re-keying (read this before mutating instances)

Blueprint tables, service nav, cards, and most slotted components **rewrite descendant instance IDs** the first time you change a slot.

Typical trigger: `remove()`, `insertChild()`, `setProperties` that swap a variant, or hiding a slotted child. After that mutation:

- Sibling IDs you captured earlier **do not exist**.
- `findAll` / `children` snapshots from before the mutation are stale.
- Reading `componentProperties` on a stale child throws `Node with id "I…" not found`.
- Failed `use_figma` scripts are **atomic** (nothing applied). The error still means the script was too aggressive.

**Working pattern**

1. Place the instance. Return the **parent instance id** and the **slot id** (`Items`, `Header + content`, `Cells`, `↳ Content`). The slot id is usually stable until you destroy the parent.
2. **One structural mutation per `use_figma` call** when removing/reordering slotted children (safest). Or, in one call, **re-fetch the slot by id before every mutation**:

```js
const slot = await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(slotId);
slot.children[slot.children.length - 1].remove();
// do not use the previous children array after this
```

3. After the first remove/hide, remaining children often get ids of the form `I{instance};{slot};{newId}`. Treat them as **new** nodes. Re-query:

```js
const slot = await figma.getNodeByIdAsync(slotId);
const visible = slot.children.filter((c) => c.visible);
```

4. Never `forEach` a cached `findAll((n) => n.type === "INSTANCE" && n.name === "Service nav item")` and then `setProperties` / `remove` later items in the same pass.

**If a script errors with `Node with id … not found`:** stop, re-read the slot, do not retry the same cached ids.

**Charts:** `guidelines-chart` § Code → Figma (plot height vs chrome; labeled mocks, not live series).

**Tables:** load **blueprint-build-table**. Do not start from `Table - column-based ❇️`.

### Fonts

Blueprint Figma components use **SF Pro** (Regular, Semibold, …) and some **SF Mono**. CSS `--font-family` is `system-ui`; do not treat that as the Figma font.

Before `appendChild` of any Blueprint instance:

```js
const fonts = await figma.listAvailableFontsAsync();
await Promise.all(
  fonts
    .filter((f) => f.fontName.family === "SF Pro" || f.fontName.family === "SF Mono")
    .map((f) => figma.loadFontAsync(f.fontName)),
);
```

`appendChild` of an instance with unloaded SF Pro throws. Loading Inter is not enough.

### Empty target files

`figma-generate-design` 2a-ii (walk existing screens) is **N/A** on an empty file. Log it and go Code Connect → keys → import.

Local `getLocalVariableCollectionsAsync()` is often empty. That does **not** mean there are no tokens. Use `search_design_system` with `includeVariables: true` scoped to `💎 Blueprint / colors`, or import known keys (e.g. `background/main`, `text/primary`).

Team files frequently already have **💎 Blueprint / components** and **💎 Blueprint / colors** in `get_libraries` → `libraries_added_to_file`. Prefer those over Astra / Cloud DS / community kits.

## Workflow

Copy and track:

```
Code-to-design:
- [ ] 1. Read React source (first visible state only unless asked)
- [ ] 2. Map Bp* → Code Connect URLs → component keys
- [ ] 3. Probe import + screenshot in a throwaway frame
- [ ] 4. Create wrapper, then one section per use_figma
- [ ] 5. Fill slots with re-fetch / one mutation per call
- [ ] 6. Screenshot, fix, delete probes and origin-strays
```

### 1. Read the source

Identify the **first page** (initial `useState`, default route). Skip empty-state placeholders unless that is the first view.

For each `Bp*` usage, note props that change Figma variants: selection, pagination, column selector, header vs prototype, inner nav labels, card property icons, table column types.

Match **code defaults**, not Figma defaults. `BpTable` props (`selection`, `columnSelector`, `pagination`) belong in **blueprint-build-table**, not here.

Format numbers the same way as code (`formatCapacity` binary, `formatThroughput` decimal). Do not invent display strings.

Layout shells (`BpPageShell`, `BpContentRegion width="wide"`) are often **not** Code Connect components. Recreate as auto-layout: page 1920 wide, content `maxWidth` 1600, padding `--space-300` (24). Bind fills to Blueprint variables when a key exists.

### 2. Resolve component keys from Code Connect (required)

Do **not** `search_design_system` for components that have a Code Connect mapping.

1. Read `{ react, fileKey, nodeId }` from `@netapp/blueprint/agent/manifests/figma-nodes.json` (app repo) or `dist/agent/manifests/figma-nodes.json` (this repo). Fallback: `// url=` + `// component=` in `react/components/*.figma.ts`.
2. `nodeId` uses colons (`65677:99546`). Hyphens in Figma URLs convert the same way.
3. Run `use_figma` on the **library** file: `getNodeByIdAsync`, walk up to `COMPONENT_SET` if the node is a variant, return `key` and `componentPropertyDefinitions`.

**No Code Connect:** `BpHeader` / `BpHeader.Prototype`. Search **only** `💎 Blueprint / components` (`includeLibraryKeys` from `get_libraries`). The chrome that matches Console is **Main header** (single component), not "Header component variants" (panel header) and not deprecated card headers.

**Icons on card properties:** `↳ Icon` is an INSTANCE_SWAP onto `2-colors-icon / …` from **💎 Blueprint / icons**. Search that library (`Data engine`, `Data LUN`, `Cost`, `Snapshot`, …). Swap the inner icon instance, not a hand-drawn SVG.

**Text styles:** page titles map to `Titles/20 . Semibold` in Blueprint components (that is `text-page-title`). Import by style key; do not use Docs / Clarity / Inter styles.

### 3. Probe before composing

Import into a **throwaway** auto-layout far from (0,0). Screenshot. Learn:

- Default variant names (`Type=Default`, `Has category 🎨=False`)
- Slot names (`Items`, `Header + content`, `↳ Content`, `Cells`)
- Nested TEXT / BOOLEAN property keys (`Label#7829:0`, `Title#4405:45`, …)

Delete the probe **and** any stray instances that landed at (0,0) after failed `appendChild` (font errors leave nothing; successful imports in a later retry can still drop extras on the page).

Skip `generate_figma_design` unless the view has **raster images** you cannot import another way. Blueprint pages of header + nav + table usually have none.

### 4. Wrapper, then sections

Create the page wrapper in its own call (1920 × hug, vertical auto-layout, `background/main`). Then:

1. Header instance, fill width
2. Horizontal **Main region**: service nav + content column
3. Content region: title, card, table — still one major section per call when possible

Service nav: set `Service#…`, keep two items, `Selected=True` on the first. Trim extra default items with re-fetch-after-each-remove.

Card: `Has header#… = false` when the React card has no `BpCardHeader`. Put properties in `↳ Content` as a horizontal auto-layout, `FILL` each property. If property labels wrap, the nested `Label + tip` / `{Property}` text is often FIXED/HUG inside the instance — set those to FILL after placing.

**BpTable:** load **blueprint-build-table**.

### 5. Validate

Screenshot the wrapper. Also screenshot the table section — full-page scale hides leftover `{Text}` rows.

Assert:

- Visible text is SF Pro (and SF Mono only where the library uses it)
- No leftover `{title}`, `{#}`, `{Text}` on **visible** nodes (hidden nested `{Aria label}` / `{Tooltip text}` on icon buttons is normal)
- Variants match code (Provider sortable/filterable only if `sortable`/`filterable`; status badges green/orange from `BpColorBadge`)

Fix with targeted calls. Do not rebuild the wrapper.

## `use_figma` hygiene (Blueprint-specific)

- Target **empty file** `fileKey` from the user URL for writes; library `fileKey` `vNPUEtCuR4Enwhz1ZeTdQE` only for key lookup.
- Return `{ createdNodeIds, mutatedNodeIds }` every time.
- `layoutSizingHorizontal = "FILL"` only after `appendChild` onto an auto-layout parent.
- Product font in Figma is SF Pro even if CSS is system-ui.
- After any slot edit, the next script must `getNodeByIdAsync` again — do not pass ids from a previous script's nested children unless you just verified they still exist.
